opportunities.title: Binance Just Burned Half Its 'Unbreakable' Insurance Fund — And Recovery Is Still Unclear
opportunities.why_now: Binance has now spent $580M of SAFU bitcoin reserves with no clear path to recouping the $6.3B hack losses, exposing the limits of exchange insurance funds in real time.
opportunities.angle: Analysis piece: what SAFU was sold as vs. what it's actually doing right now — a case study in why 'insurance fund' marketing doesn't survive contact with a real breach.

opportunities.title: Arbitrum's Council Just Moved $30M of Hacker Funds Without the Hacker's Key — Here's Why That Should Worry You Too
opportunities.why_now: A DAO council unilaterally relocating stolen funds without the private key raises uncomfortable questions about who actually controls 'decentralized' chains when a big enough theft happens.
opportunities.angle: Explainer/opinion: the precedent this sets for every chain with an 'emergency powers' multisig — if they can move it, so can anyone with the right access.

opportunities.title: One New Laundering Wallet Every 25 Seconds: Inside North Korea's Industrialized Theft Pipeline
opportunities.why_now: Chainalysis-tracked data shows DPRK hackers are laundering the Binance hack proceeds at an automated, assembly-line pace that outstrips any freeze-and-chase response.
opportunities.angle: Data-driven breakdown with a timeline graphic: why 'we're tracking the funds' headlines are theater against this kind of throughput.

opportunities.title: Claude Wrote an Exploit for a Linux Bug Ubuntu Still Hasn't Patched — Your Node Is the Next Target
opportunities.why_now: An AI model autonomously built a working exploit for an unpatched Ubuntu vulnerability, a direct preview of AI-accelerated attacks on crypto infrastructure.
opportunities.angle: Security warning piece: translate this from 'Linux bug' to 'your validator/node server runs this OS' and lay out patch urgency.

opportunities.title: Proton's CEO Called Security Caution 'Loser Thinking.' This Week Proved Exactly Why That's Wrong.
opportunities.why_now: Days after the Binance hack and Mercado Bitcoin breach dominate headlines, Proton users are revolting against their own CEO downplaying security in favor of an AI push — a tone-deaf moment that writes its own headline.
opportunities.angle: Commentary/takedown piece contrasting the CEO's rhetoric against the week's hack toll — 'already know how this ends' voice at its sharpest.
